target.value: - ECFR authors 50 public commentaries. - ECFRs policy experts are mentioned in the press over 250 times. - ECFR MENA organises over 35 public and private events. - ECFR MENA products get viewed over 2500 times each on average.

actual.value: -Authored 54 commentaries and op-eds -ECFRs policy experts have been mentioned over 300 times -Convened 35 public, private, hybrid and virtual convenings across European capitals. -ECFRs resource Mapping Palestinian Politics website has been viewed over 380,000 times, making it ECFRs most visited page in 2024, -ECFR MENAs podcasts were listened to over 85,000 times.
